content:
Apple TV's three-episode documentary series about the UConn women's basketball team is now available to stream. Check out the trailer below.

《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》premiering on Apple TV

Apple TV subscribers can now stream all three episodes of 《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》, its latest sports-themed documentary.

《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》features interviews with "coaches, athletes, alumni, rivals, and journalists" from throughout the history of UConn basketball, directed by Matthew Hamachek (Tiger) and Erica Sashin (Wrong Man).

Here's how Apple TV describes the series:

《Dynasty: UConn Huskies》joins Apple TV's growing lineup of sports content, which includes 《Ted Lasso》, 《The Dink》, 《Stick》, 《F1 The Movie》, 《Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series》, 《Onside: Major League Soccer》, 《Messi's World Cup: The Rise of a Legend》, and 《Stephen Curry: Underrated》, among others.

Apple TV also confirmed earlier today the return date for 《Stick》 and announced the addition of a new cast member who will be very familiar to fans of the platform's hit series 《Pluribus》.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or can be bundled via Apple One. The service offers hit shows and movies including 《Ted Lasso》, 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》, and 《Silo》, among others.
